Class ViewPlayer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.ui.view.ViewPlayer
public class ViewPlayer extends Object
ViewPlayer class represents a simplified version (client-side) of the Player and ShipBoard classes (server-side)
